name: weave
description: Netwoven Weave turns notes, transcripts, estimates, and drafts into client-ready Word documents, PowerPoint decks, and statements of work on the Netwoven 2026 templates, then reviews any deliverable against Netwoven's quality standard. Answer-first structure, exact numbers, house writing rules, brand palette, and validators that block template leakage.

author_name.title: Your name
author_name.description: Shown on the revision history page of documents you build.

author_role.title: Your role
author_role.description: Shown next to your name on the revision history page, for example Senior Consultant.

telemetry_enabled.title: Share anonymised usage events
telemetry_enabled.description: Sends deliverable type, template version, pass or fail, and duration to Netwoven's usage list. Never prompt text, file names, or client names. Turn off any time.

telemetry_endpoint.title: Usage list endpoint
telemetry_endpoint.description: Set by the plugin team. Leave blank to keep events on this device only.

telemetry_tenant_id.title: Usage list tenant ID
telemetry_tenant_id.description: Set by the plugin team. The Microsoft Entra tenant that owns the usage list's site.

telemetry_client_id.title: Usage list client ID
telemetry_client_id.description: Set by the plugin team. Application (client) ID of the usage-list sign-in app.
